summary: CONX Corp., via subsidiary CONX Broadcast Group, completed its acquisition of approximately 75% of HC2 Broadcasting Holdings Inc. common stock on September 1, 2026, pursuant to an Agreement and Plan of Merger dated May 29, 2026. Merger Sub merged with and into HC2, with HC2 surviving as a subsidiary. At closing, non-Merger Sub HC2 shares were converted into 25% of post-closing shares; Merger Sub interests converted into 75%. HC2 was subsequently converted to an LLC, with a three-member board (two CONX-appointed, one Seller/Innovate-appointed). No price per share or premium was disclosed. What to watch: post-closing adjustments under the LLC Agreement and potential minority-interest governance dynamics.
